import calendar

def f(s):
    months = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']
    # Split the input string into year and month
    year, month = map(int, s.split('-'))
    # Calculate the quarter and year for the given month
    q = int(calendar.isleap(year) and (month // 3) + 1 or (month // 3))
    return '{} Q{}'.format(months[q - 1], year)
